title: Keep a three-column error log
summary: Write the wrong sentence, the fixed sentence, and the one-line reason beside it.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Mistakes repeat in patterns, and a log makes the pattern visible. Use three columns: the sentence as you said or wrote it, the corrected version, and a short reason such as missing measure word or wrong negation. Add an example of your own to the fixed line, because producing a new correct sentence is what closes the loop. Read the reason column once a week; when one reason appears four times, that is your next lesson and the one worth drilling.
